s: $$\begin{aligned} & x = 3 + 2\sqrt 2 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 2 + 1 + 2\sqrt 2 \\ & \Rightarrow x = {\left( {\sqrt 2 + 1} \right)^2} \\ & \Rightarrow \sqrt x = \sqrt 2 + 1 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{{\sqrt x }} = \frac{1}{{\sqrt 2 + 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{{\sqrt x }} = \frac{1}{{\sqrt 2 + 1}} \times \frac{{\sqrt 2 - 1}}{{\sqrt 2 - 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{{\sqrt x }} = \sqrt 2 - 1 \\ & \therefore \sqrt x - \frac{1}{{\sqrt x }} \\ & = \sqrt 2 + 1 - \left( {\sqrt 2 - 1} \right) \\ & = \sqrt 2 + 1 - \sqrt 2 + 1 \\ & = 2 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$a = \frac{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}$$ & $$b = \frac{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{\text{,}}$$ then the value of $$\frac{{{a^2} + ab + {b^2}}}{{{a^2} - ab + {b^2}}}{\text{ is?}}$$
s: $$\begin{aligned} & a = \frac{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{{\sqrt 5 - 1}} \\ & b = \frac{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{\text{ }} \\ & \therefore a = \frac{1}{b} \\ & a + b = a + \frac{1}{a} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{\text{ + }}\frac{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{{\sqrt 5 + 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{5 + 1 + 2\sqrt 5 + 5 + 1 - 2\sqrt 5 }}{{{{\left( {\sqrt 5 } \right)}^2} - {{\left( 1 \right)}^2}}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{6 + 2\sqrt 5 + 6 - 2\sqrt 5 }}{{5 - 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{12}}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow 3 \\ & \therefore \frac{{{a^2} + ab + {b^2}}}{{{a^2} - ab + {b^2}}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{{a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} + ab}}{{{a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} - ab}} \\ & \Rightarrow a + \frac{1}{a} = 3 \\ & \Rightarrow {a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} \\ & \Rightarrow 9 - 2 \\ & \Rightarrow 7\left( {ab = 1} \right) \\ & \therefore \frac{{{a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} + ab}}{{{a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} - ab}} \\ & = \frac{{7 + 1}}{{7 - 1}} \\ & = \frac{8}{6} \\ & = \frac{4}{3} \end{aligned}$$

s: $$\begin{aligned} & x = \frac{{\sqrt 3 }}{2} \\ & {\text{or }}1 + x = 1 + \frac{{\sqrt 3 }}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{2 + \sqrt 3 }}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{2\left( {2 + \sqrt 3 } \right)}}{{2 \times 2}} \\ & \left( {{\text{Divided and multiply by 2}}} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{4 + 2\sqrt 3 }}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{1 + 3 + 2\sqrt 3 }}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{4 + 2\sqrt 3 }}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{{{\left( 1 \right)}^2} + {{\left( {\sqrt 3 } \right)}^2} + 2.1.\sqrt 3 }}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow 1 + x = \frac{{{{\left( {1 + \sqrt 3 } \right)}^2}}}{4} \\ & \therefore \sqrt {1 + x} = \frac{{1 + \sqrt 3 }}{2} \\ & \\ & {\bf{Similarly:}} \\ & \sqrt {1 - x} \\ & = \frac{{\sqrt 3 - 1}}{2} \\ & \therefore \frac{{\sqrt {1 + x} }}{{1 + \sqrt {1 + x} }}{\text{ + }}\frac{{\sqrt {1 - x} }}{{1 - \sqrt {1 - x} }} \\ & = \frac{{\frac{{1 + \sqrt 3 }}{2}}}{{1 + \frac{{1 + \sqrt 3 }}{2}}} + \frac{{\frac{{\sqrt 3 - 1}}{2}}}{{1 - \frac{{\sqrt 3 - 1}}{2}}} \\ & = \frac{{1 + \sqrt 3 }}{{3 + \sqrt 3 }} + \frac{{\sqrt 3 - 1}}{{3 - \sqrt 3 }} \\ & = \frac{{1 + \sqrt 3 }}{{\sqrt 3 \left( {\sqrt 3 + 1} \right)}} + \frac{{1 - \sqrt 3 }}{{\sqrt 3 \left( {\sqrt 3 - 1} \right)}} \\ & = \frac{1}{{\sqrt 3 }} + \frac{1}{{\sqrt 3 }} \\ & = \frac{2}{{\sqrt 3 }} \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$a + \frac{1}{b} = 1$$ and $$b + \frac{1}{c} = 1$$ then $$c + \frac{1}{a}$$ is equal to?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & a + \frac{1}{b} = 1{\text{, }}b + \frac{1}{c} = 1{\text{, }}c + \frac{1}{a} = ? \\ & {\text{Put values, }} \\ & a = \frac{1}{2},b = 2,{\text{ }}c = - 1 \\ & c + \frac{1}{a} \\ & = - 1 + \frac{1}{{\left( {\frac{1}{2}} \right)}} \\ & = - 1 + 2 \\ & = 1 \\ & \\ & {\bf{Alternate:}} \\ & \Rightarrow a + \frac{1}{b} = 1 \\ & \Rightarrow a = 1 - \frac{1}{b} = \boxed{\frac{{b - 1}}{b}} \\ & \frac{1}{a} = \frac{b}{{b - 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow b + \frac{1}{c} = 1 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{c} = 1 - b,\boxed{c = \frac{1}{{1 - b}}} \\ & \therefore c + \frac{1}{a} \\ & = \frac{1}{{1 - b}} + \frac{b}{{b - 1}} \\ & = \frac{1}{{1 - b}} - \frac{b}{{1 - b}} \\ & = \frac{{1 - b}}{{1 - b}} \\ & = 1 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$x + \frac{9}{x} = 6{\text{,}}$$ then $$\left( {{x^2} + \frac{9}{{{x^2}}}} \right)$$ is equal to?

If $$a + \frac{1}{a} + 1 = 0\left( {a \ne 0} \right){\text{,}}$$ then the value of $$\left( {{a^4} - a} \right)\,{\text{is?}}$$
s: $$\begin{aligned} & a + \frac{1}{a} + 1 = 0 \\ & a + \frac{1}{a} = - 1 \\ & {\text{Squaring both sides}} \\ & \Rightarrow {a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} + 2 = 1 \\ & \Rightarrow {a^2} + \frac{1}{{{a^2}}} = - 1 \\ & \Rightarrow {a^2} + 1 = - \frac{1}{{{a^2}}}\,.....(i) \\ & \Rightarrow a + \frac{1}{a} = - 1{\text{ }}\left( {{\text{Given}}} \right) \\ & \therefore {a^2} + 1 = - a\,.....(ii) \\ & \Rightarrow - a = \frac{{ - 1}}{{{a^2}}} \\ & {\text{For equation (i) and (ii)}} \\ & {{\text{a}}^3} = 1 \\ & \therefore {{\text{a}}^3} - 1 = 0 \\ & \Rightarrow {a^4} - a = a\left( {{a^3} - 1} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow {a^4} - a = a \times 0 \\ & \Rightarrow {a^4} - a = 0 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$x = a + \frac{1}{a}$$ and $$y = a - \frac{1}{a},$$ then the value of x 4 + y 4 - 2x 2 y 2 is?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & x = a + \frac{1}{a} \\ & y = a - \frac{1}{a} \\ & \therefore \left( {x + y} \right) = a + \frac{1}{a} + a - \frac{1}{a} = 2a \\ & \therefore \left( {x - y} \right) = a + \frac{1}{a} - a + \frac{1}{a} = \frac{2}{a} \\ & \therefore {x^4}{\text{ + }}{{\text{y}}^4} - 2{x^2}{y^2} \\ & = {\left( {{x^2} - {y^2}} \right)^2} \\ & = {\left[ {\left( {x + y} \right)\left( {x - y} \right)} \right]^2} \\ & = {\left( {2a \times \frac{2}{a}} \right)^2} \\ & = {\left( 4 \right)^2} \\ & = 16 \end{aligned}$$

q: If p = 101, then the value of $$\sqrt[3]{p\left( {{p^2} - 3p + 3} \right) - 1}$$ is?
If 50% of (p - q) = 30% of (p + q), then p : q is equal to?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & 50\% {\text{ of }}\left( {p - q} \right) = 30\% {\text{ of }}\left( {p + q} \right) \\ & \frac{{p - q}}{2} = \frac{3}{{10}}\left( {p + q} \right) \\ & \left[ {50\% = \frac{1}{2}} \right] \\ & \Rightarrow 5\left( {p - q} \right) = 3\left( {p + q} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 5p - 5q = 3p + 3q \\ & \Rightarrow 2p = 8q \\ & \Rightarrow 1p = 4q \\ & \Rightarrow p:q = 4:1 \end{aligned}$$

q: If x : y = 2 : 1, then (5x 2 - 13xy + 6y 2 ) is equal to ?
If $$\frac{a}{3} = \frac{b}{2}{\text{,}}$$ then the value of $$\frac{{2a + 3b}}{{3a - 2b}}\,{\text{is?}}$$
If $$\frac{{2x - y}}{{x + 2y}} = \frac{1}{2}{\text{,}}$$ then value of $$\frac{{3x - y}}{{3x + y}}\,{\text{is?}}$$
s: $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{2x - y}}{{x + 2y}}\, \times \frac{1}{2}\left( {{\text{Cross multiply}}} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow 4x - 2y = x + 2y \\ & \Rightarrow 3x = 4y \\ & \Rightarrow x:y = 4:3 \\ & \therefore \frac{{3x - y}}{{3x + y}}{\text{ }} \\ & {\text{ = }}\frac{{3 \times 4 - 3}}{{3 \times 4 + 3}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\frac{{12 - 3}}{{12 + 3}} \\ & {\text{ = }}\frac{9}{{15}}{\text{ }} \\ & {\text{ = }}\frac{3}{5} \end{aligned}$$

$${\text{If }}\frac{{4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 }}{{\sqrt {48} + \sqrt {18} }} = a + b\sqrt 6 {\text{,}}$$ then the value of a and b are respectively?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & \frac{{4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 }}{{\sqrt {48} + \sqrt {18} }} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 }}{{\sqrt {16 \times 3} + \sqrt {9 \times 2} }} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 }}{{4\sqrt 3 + 3\sqrt 2 }} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 }}{{4\sqrt 3 + 3\sqrt 2 }} \times \frac{{4\sqrt 3 - 3\sqrt 2 }}{{4\sqrt 3 - 3\sqrt 2 }} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{\left( {4\sqrt 3 + 5\sqrt 2 } \right)\left( {4\sqrt 3 - 3\sqrt 2 } \right)}}{{48 - 18}} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{8\sqrt 6 + 18}}{{30}} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{8\sqrt 6 }}{{30}} + \frac{{18}}{{30}} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{4}{{15}}\sqrt 6 + \frac{3}{5} = a + b\sqrt 6 \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{3}{5} + \frac{4}{{15}}\sqrt 6 = a + b\sqrt 6 \end{aligned}$$ By comparing coefficients of rational and irrational parts. $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow a = \frac{3}{5}{\text{ , }}b = \frac{4}{{15}} \\ & \therefore \left( {\frac{3}{5},\frac{4}{{15}}} \right) \end{aligned}$$

If $$\sqrt {0.04 \times 0.4 \times a}$$ = 0.004 × 0.4 × $$\sqrt b ,$$ then the value of $$\frac{a}{b}\,{\text{is?}}$$
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ }}\sqrt {0.04 \times 0.4 \times a} = 0.004 \times 0.4 \times \sqrt b \\ & \Rightarrow \sqrt {\frac{4}{{100}} \times \frac{4}{{10}} \times a} = \frac{4}{{1000}} \times \frac{4}{{10}} \times \sqrt b \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{4}{{10}}\sqrt {\frac{a}{{10}}} = \frac{4}{{10}} \times \frac{4}{{1000}} \times \sqrt b \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{a}{{10}} = \frac{{16}}{{1000000}} \times b \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{a}{b} = \frac{{16 \times 10}}{{1000000}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{a}{b} = \frac{{16}}{{100000}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{a}{b} = 16 \times {10^{ - 5}} \end{aligned}$$

q: If x varies inversely as (y 2 - 1) and x is equal to 24 when y = 10, then the value of x when y = 5 is?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & x \propto \frac{1}{{{y^2} - 1}}{\text{ }}\left( {{\text{Given}}} \right) \\ & x = k \times \frac{1}{{{y^2} - 1}}\left( {k{\text{ is constant}}} \right) \\ & {\text{Now }}x = 24{\text{ when }}y = 10{\text{ given}} \\ & \Rightarrow 24 = k \times \frac{1}{{{{\left( {10} \right)}^2} - 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow 24 = \frac{k}{{99}} \\ & \Rightarrow k = 24 \times 99 \\ & x = ? \\ & y = 5 \\ & \Rightarrow x = 24 \times 99 \times \frac{1}{{25 - 1}} \\ & \Rightarrow x = 24 \times 99 \times \frac{1}{{24}} \\ & \Rightarrow x = 99 \end{aligned}$$

q: If x 2 + y 2 + 2x + 1 = 0, then the value of x 31 + y 35 is?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {x^2} + {y^2} + 2x + 1 = 0 \\ & \Rightarrow {x^2} + 2x + 1 + {y^2} = 0 \\ & \Rightarrow {\left( {x + 1} \right)^2} + {y^2} = 0 \end{aligned}$$ Hence both terms are squares and there addition is zero. So, it can be possible only when both terms are zeros. $$\begin{aligned} & \therefore x + 1 = 0 \\ & \Rightarrow x = - 1 \\ & y = 0 \\ & \therefore {x^{31}} + {y^{35}} \\ & \Rightarrow {\left( { - 1} \right)^{31}} + {\left( 0 \right)^{35}} \\ & \Rightarrow - 1 \end{aligned}$$

q: If a, b, c are real and a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 2(a - b - c) -3, then the value of 2a - 3b + 4c is?
If (3a + 1) 2 + (b - 1) 2 + (2c - 3) 2 = 0 then the value of (3a + b + 2c) is equal to?

The value of the expression $$\frac{{{{\left( {a - b} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {b - c} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {c - a} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)}}$$ = ?
s: $$\frac{{{{\left( {a - b} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {b - c} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {c - a} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)}}$$ Now, $$\Rightarrow \frac{{{{\left( {a - b} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} \times \frac{{\left( {a - b} \right)}}{{a - b}}$$ Multiply divide by (a - b) in 1 st term Multiply divide by (b - c) in 2 nd term Multiply divide by (c - a) in 3 rd term $$\Rightarrow \frac{{{{\left( {a - b} \right)}^2}\left( {a - b} \right)}}{{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)\left( {a - b} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {b - c} \right)}^2}\left( {b - c} \right)}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} +$$ $$\frac{{{{\left( {c - a} \right)}^2}\left( {c - a} \right)}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}}$$ $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Let, }}a - b = x \\ & b - c = y \\ & c - a = z \\ & \therefore x + y + z = 0 \\ & \therefore {x^3} + {y^3} + {z^3} = 3xyz \\ & \therefore {\left( {a - b} \right)^2} + {\left( {b - c} \right)^2} + {\left( {c - a} \right)^2} \\ & = 3\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right) \\ & \therefore \frac{{3\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}}{{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {c - a} \right)}} \\ & = 3 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $${a^{\frac{1}{3}}} = 11,$$ then the value of a 2 - 331a is?
If a 2 + b 2 = 2 and c 2 + d 2 = 1, then the value of (ad - bc) 2 + (ac - bd) 2 is?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {a^2} + {b^2} = 2{\text{ }} \\ & {c^2} + {d^2} = 1 \\ & {\text{Put values of }}a,{\text{ }}b,{\text{ }}c,{\text{ }}d \\ & {\text{Take ,}}a = b = 1 \\ & c = 1 \\ & d = 0 \\ & \Rightarrow {\left( {ad - bc} \right)^2}{\text{ + }}{\left( {ac - bd} \right)^2} \\ & \Rightarrow {\left( {0 - 1} \right)^2} + {\left( {1 + 0} \right)^2} \\ & \Rightarrow {\left( { - 1} \right)^2} + {\left( 1 \right)^2} \\ & \Rightarrow 2 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$x = \frac{{4ab}}{{a + b}}{\text{ }}a \ne b,$$ the value of $$\frac{{x + 2a}}{{x - 2a}}$$ + $$\frac{{x + 2b}}{{x - 2b}}$$ is?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{ }}x = \frac{{4ab}}{{a + b}}{\text{ }} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{x}{{2a}} = {\text{ }}\frac{{2b}}{{a + b}}{\text{ }} \\ & \frac{{x + 2a}}{{x - 2a}} \\ & = \frac{{2b + a + b}}{{2b - a - b}} \\ & = \frac{{3b + a}}{{b - a}} \end{aligned}$$ ( By Componendo and Dividendo rule ) $$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow {\text{again}}\frac{x}{{2b}} = \frac{{2a}}{{a + b}} \\ & \frac{{x + 2b}}{{x - 2b}} \\ & = \frac{{2a + a + b}}{{2a - a - b}} \\ & = \frac{{3a + b}}{{a - b}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{x + 2a}}{{x - 2a}}{\text{ + }}\frac{{x + 2b}}{{x - 2b}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{3b + a}}{{b - a}} - \frac{{3a + b}}{{a - b}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{3b + a - 3a - b}}{{b - a}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{2b - 2a}}{{b - a}} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{{2\left( {b - a} \right)}}{{\left( {b - a} \right)}} \\ & \Rightarrow 2 \end{aligned}$$

q: If $$3x + \frac{1}{{2x}} = 5{\text{,}}$$ then the value of $${\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}}\,{\text{is?}}$$
s: $$\begin{aligned} & 3x + \frac{1}{{2x}} = 5 \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{Multiply both sides by }}\frac{2}{3} \\ & \therefore 3x \times \frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{2}x \times \frac{2}{3} = 5 \times \frac{2}{3} \\ & \Rightarrow 2x + \frac{1}{{3x}} = \frac{{10}}{3} \\ & \therefore {\text{Taking cube on both sides}} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} + 3.2x.\frac{1}{{3x}}\left( {{\text{ 2}}x{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{3x}}} \right) = {\left( {\frac{{10}}{3}} \right)^3} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} + 2\left( {\frac{{10}}{3}} \right) = \left( {\frac{{1000}}{{27}}} \right) \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} = \frac{{1000}}{{27}} - \frac{{20}}{3} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} = \frac{{1000 - 180}}{{27}} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} = \frac{{820}}{{27}} \\ & \Rightarrow {\text{8}}{x^3}{\text{ + }}\frac{1}{{27{x^3}}} = 30\frac{{10}}{{27}} \end{aligned}$$
